title: Consumption of Same Origin
next_chapter_hook: When the threads of destiny are forcibly intertwined, how will the temporary alliance between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander withstand the ultimate pursuit of the Heavenly Eye? And what hidden curse will the mere thirty percent completion of the fusion plant within him?

text.content: At the bottom of the abyss, the blood-colored patterns on the altar suddenly blazed to life, like a giant python dormant for a thousand years awakening, slowly crawling up the intertwined hands of Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander. Threads of destiny woven in the void emitted faint yet piercing hums—that was the lament of Heavenly Principles being shaken. A flash of resolve crossed the Demonic Path commander's eyes: 'It has begun.' Chen Ji felt an unfamiliar and violent force surging into his body—that was the roar of another river of destiny, colliding violently with the power of the Tianji Record within him.

dialogue.content:
'Are you certain about this?' The Demonic Path commander's voice rare carried a hint of trembling. 'Once the fusion of destiny begins, there's no turning back. If something goes wrong—'

'There is no 'if'.' Chen Ji interrupted her, a faint, indifferent smile playing at the corner of his lips—a smile utterly different from the docile servant who sweeps floors at the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. 'I've waited for this day far too long.'

text.content: Before the words even faded, the heavens tore apart. A purple thunderbolt imbued with destructive might came crashing down from the fissure, its power far exceeding ordinary Heavenly Tribulation, as if Heaven itself had descended with will to crush this ant who dared profane the forbidden mysteries of destiny into dust. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—he had never seen this in his visions, for what was happening now had already exceeded the calculative scope of the Tianji Record.

'Fetters Counter-Reverse—Open!' At the critical moment, Chen Ji bellowed. The long-sealed Author's mark at his Brow Center suddenly blazed brilliantly, golden light exploding from his body and condensing into a massive shield inscribed with ancient runes above the two of them. The Heavenly Tribulation struck the shield's surface, stirring万丈 of thunder light, yet it was barely held back for a moment. Author's Authority—this was his most deeply hidden trump card, a power not even recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content:
'The Author...' The Demonic Path commander's pupils quivered violently. 'You actually—'

'Surprised?' Blood seeped from Chen Ji's temples, yet his smile grew increasingly composed. 'Didn't the Saintess say that destiny can be fused? Then let Heaven see—its own chess game can be overturned by the Author's own hands!'

text.content: The golden shield cracked with countless fine lines under the Heavenly Tribulation's assault. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value burning frantically—each crack meant years of lifespan being consumed. But he did not retreat; instead, he tightly gripped the Demonic Path commander's wrist with his other hand, pouring his remaining Author's power continuously into that barrier. The ritual of destiny fusion not only did not stop, but accelerated under this external pressure.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Tribulation grew increasingly violent; the Author's barrier was nearing its limit. Chen Ji must make a choice at destiny's crossroads—

choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value to complete the fusion, even if only thirty percent is sufficient to obtain the opponent's complete combat memories. This is a desperate gamble to turn death into survival.
choices.visible_reward: Obtained Demonic Path Commander's Complete Combat Memories
choices.risk_hint: Failed fusion will backlash against oneself, possible instant death

text.content: Chen Ji erupted with a roar, the Tianji Record Fragment in his body spinning madly as the golden barrier shattered into countless specks of light. Simultaneously, an unprecedented power exploded from his Dantian. The Demonic Path commander's river of destiny flooded into him like a breached dam, the two threads of destiny biting together死死 at the thirty percent intersection. The intense agony caused Chen Ji to howl skyward, blood seeping from all seven orifices, yet his eyes burned with mad exhilaration.

dialogue.content:
'It worked...' The Demonic Path commander gazed at this blood-soaked yet wildly laughing man, her voice carrying a tremor she herself hadn't noticed. 'You madman...'

'Madman?' Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, his gaze deep as an abyss. 'No, I am the Author. If Heaven wants to destroy me, I'll be the one to flip Heaven's chessboard first.'

choices.description: Interrupt the fusion, each using full strength to withstand the Heavenly Tribulation. Preserve strength for later use, but this means the Demonic Path commander cannot obtain Chen Ji's Tianji Record power.
choices.visible_reward: Preserved Heavenly Fate Value, both parties' strength intact
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Tribulation's power not diminished but increased, impossible for a single person to resist

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly released the Demonic Path commander's wrist, his figure leaping back three zhang. The golden barrier, deprived of support, collapsed instantly, the countless golden fragments scattering like fireflies. The Demonic Path commander, caught off guard, eyes wide with fury: 'You—!'

'What 'you' what?' Chen Ji wiped the blood from his temple, his voice coldly indifferent as ever. 'Didn't the Saintess say destiny can be fused? But I never said I'd fill the gap with my own life.'

dialogue.content:
'Chen Ji!' The Demonic Path commander gritted her teeth. 'You dare toy with me?'

'Dare? No.' Chen Ji smiled faintly. 'I just prefer seeing my enemies' expressions of despair more than gambling my life. Watch closely—'

He raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment spinning rapidly in his palm, actually tearing off a strand of Heavenly Tribulation power and swallowing it into his body.

choices.description: Temporarily blind Heaven's will with Author's authority to buy time for fusion. This is a high-risk, high-reward option requiring extremely strong judgment.
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao Will Temporarily Obscured, Fusion Success Rate Increased
choices.risk_hint: If Obscuration Fails, Will Suffer Double Heavenly Dao Retaliation

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed, and a secret rune suddenly illuminated in his palm. That was the most forbidden technique within the Writer's Authority—「Tianji Dust」. In an instant, the countless purple thunder seemed to lose its target, striking madly above the two heads yet always missing by a hair's breadth. The will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was temporarily shielded, and the might of the Heavenly Calamity plummeted by thirty percent.

dialogue.content: 「Now!」 Chen Ji shouted, gripping the demonic commander commander commander commander commander commander commander's wrist. The threads of destiny interwove madly in this brief respite, and the two rivers of fate merged with even greater ferocity than before. The demonic commander sensed an unprecedented power surging from within Chen Ji—the thousand-year accumulated wisdom of a Writer and the fragmented truth of the Tianji Record. 「Enough!」 Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, golden light blazing in his pupils, 「Thirty percent—足够了!」

text.content: Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the Heavenly Calamity's remnants were ultimately weakened to a bearable range. And the instant the Heavenly Calamity vanished, an icy gaze pierced through the void from beyond the Nine Heavens, locking directly onto the two figures on the altar. That gaze contained no emotion whatsoever, yet it caused every hair on Chen Ji's body to stand on end—it was the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

dialogue.content: 「Writer...」 A will transcending the limits of sound directly灌入 Chen Ji's mind, 「You are courting destruction.」 Chen Ji laughed wildly at the sky, his voice carrying unrestrained mockery: 「Courting destruction? Lord Heavenly Dao, you have laid out this sacrificial chess game for tens of millions of years—did you ever imagine being counterattacked by a chess piece you raised yourself?」

text.content: The rift in the sky healed slowly, yet that icy gaze clung like a bone-deep parasite. Chen Ji knew the Heavenly Dao's Eye had noticed him—this meant from now on, he would formally become a targeted variable in the Heavenly Dao's chess game. However, he felt no fear at this moment, because during the刚才的融合, he had obtained nearly a thousand years of battle memories and secret technique inheritances from the demonic commander.

The洪流 of memories surged through Chen Ji's识海. He witnessed the demonic Holy Sect's hundred-year campaign of bloody battlefields, saw the saint licking her wounds alone in the dark nights, and also saw that soul discarded by the Holy Sect yet still gritting its teeth to struggle. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, and in his gaze toward the demonic commander appeared a complex emotion: 「So you are also a chess piece.」

dialogue.content: The demonic commander沉默片刻, a self-deprecating smile curling at his lips: 「Why should one chess piece为难 another? You and I are merely two broken pieces on the Heavenly Dao's chessboard. Now that we've come together, we might just overturn the entire game.」 「Well said.」 Chen Ji extended his blood-stained palm, 「Since destiny has made us devour our own kind, let the Heavenly Dao see how far two broken pieces can go together.」 「From now on,」 the demonic commander's hand tightly clasped his, 「I am your ally.」

text.content: The blood-colored patterns on the altar gradually dimmed, and the ritual of destiny fusion finally concluded. Although only thirty percent was completed, it had already caused Chen Ji's strength to undergo a qualitative leap. More importantly, he was no longer alone—the demonic saint's joining meant he finally had筹码 to face the Heavenly Dao's Eye head-on. Though the Writer's Authority had fallen into cooldown, the text on the Tianji Record Fragment had become even clearer than before, as if responding to his earth-shaking act just now.

dialogue.content: 「Well done.」 An aged voice emerged from the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickering in the golden light, 「Constraint reversal, Tianji Dust... you've走得比我想象的更远.」 Chen Ji frowned slightly: 「Mo Xiansheng, what exactly is that 'higher existence' behind the Heavenly Dao's Eye?」 Mo Xiansheng沉默片刻, sighing: 「Some answers, you're not yet ready to know. But I can tell you one thing—the things you did today have already触动了 that one's逆鳞. From now on, the real pursuit, has just begun.」

text.content: Beyond the abyss, the wind and clouds changed color. Although the purple-black tribulation clouds originally shrouding the altar had dispersed, more dark clouds were gathering from all directions. Those were the Heavenly Dao's eyes re-focusing, a precursor to the higher existence's will beginning to awaken. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of oppression surging toward him like a tide, but he did not retreat; instead, he gripped the demonic commander's hand even tighter: 「So be it. This game, I accept.」

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's gaze was like芒刺在背, Chen Ji needed to decide the direction of his next action—

choices.description: Strike first before the Heavenly Dao's will is completely locked, proactively destroy its perceptual nodes in this realm. Extremely high risk, but if successful can buy precious time.
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao Perception Weakened for Three Days

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned cold, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm suddenly unfolded. Using the Writer's Authority, he traced the source of the Heavenly Dao's will, locking onto a hidden node in the void—that was the perceptual tendril the Heavenly Dao's Eye projected into this realm. The demonic commander understood, demonic energy surging around his body: 「I'll clear the way for you.」

dialogue.content: Two silhouettes dashed through the sky like meteors, directly crashing into that intangible node. In an instant, the void trembled, and a deafening哀鸣 came from the depths of the heavens—that was the wail of the Heavenly Dao's perception being severed. Chen Ji and the demonic commander were covered in blood, yet they smiled at each other. 「Three days.」 Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, his eyes flickering with madness, 「We've bought three days.」

choices.description: Use the demonic saint's identity as cover, infiltrate the Holy Sect's interior to accumulate strength. Retreat to advance, set up a bigger chess game in the shadows.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the identity of the Demonic Path Commander

text.content: 'Not in a hurry.' Chen Ji suppressed his aura, resuming his harmless good-for-nothing appearance. 'Since the Heavenly Dao has set its sights on me, direct confrontation is not the wise choice. Saint Maiden, would you be willing to show me the true depth of the Demonic Path Holy Sect?'

dialogue.content:
The Demonic Path Commander raised an eyebrow, wearing an enigmatic smile: 'You certainly have excellent calculations, using my identity as cover while secretly amassing strength against the Heavenly Dao?'

'Mutual benefit, that's all.' Chen Ji shrugged. 'Besides... don't you also want to know what those old things in the Holy Sect are scheming?'

After contemplating for a moment, the Demonic Path Commander finally nodded: 'Let's go. But I must be clear—if you dare betray me, even if I have to chase you to the ends of the earth, I will take your life myself.'

'Rest assured.' Chen Ji smiled meaningfully. 'I despise betrayal more than anyone.'

text.content: Just as the two were about to leave the altar, an aged and cold voice rang out from the Void: 'Chen Ji, my dear disciple-grandson, did you think hiding here could deceive this old man?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that voice was all too familiar. It was Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing. That old fox who had seemingly sheltered him while harboring malicious intent had actually chased after him here.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's figure materialized slowly from the Void, his turbid old eyes flickering with greed and spite: 'The Penholder's authority... the Tianji Record... so this waste was hiding such an astonishing secret! But did you think a mere Demonic Path Saint could protect you?'

A mocking arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, his voice平静得近乎冷漠：'Ling Yuan, Elder, since when have you left Tianqing Sect to enjoy your twilight years? Why come to this remote backwater? Could it be... you're afraid I might discover something I shouldn't?'

text.content:
Ling Yuan's expression darkened like cold water. He slowly raised his hand, an overwhelming pressure crushing down on Chen Ji like a mountain collapsing: 'This old man originally wanted to spare your life. After all, you are Chen Xuan's inheritor, and there are things I need to slowly extract from you. But since you're so eager to seek death—'

'Seek death?' Chen Ji laughed lightly, his aura suddenly surging. The power from the three-tenths fusion burst forth in its entirety, actually holding back Ling Yuan's pressure. 'Ling Yuan, Elder, are you certain... it's the two of us seeking death?'

Ling Yuan's gaze swept over the Demonic Path Commander beside Chen Ji, his pupils slightly constricting. Though he didn't know what happened on the altar, he keenly sensed the blending of aura between these two—a characteristic that appears only after fated destinies intertwine. The old fox's eyes flickered with a hint of wariness, quickly replaced by deeper greed: 'Fate fusion? You dared commit such an act of great defiance... No wonder the Heavenly Dao rages.'

'So what?' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his demeanor composed to the point of arrogance. 'The Tianji Record inheritance you've schemed for all this time is now in my hands. Want to seize it?'

He tilted his head to look at the Demonic Path Commander, his smile growing more playful: 'Saint Maiden, it seems our temporary alliance's first battle will use Tianqing Sect's old ancestor as the offering.'

dialogue.content:
The Demonic Path Commander snorted coldly, demonic energy coiling around her like dragons and serpents: 'A half-dead old relic dares to call itself an enemy?'

Ling Yuan trembled with rage, killing intent blazing in his turbid old eyes: 'Arrogant fool! This old man has cultivated for a thousand years—how dare you two juniors insult me!'

'A thousand years?' Chen Ji shook his head, his tone carrying a hint of pity. 'Ling Yuan Elder, of your thousand years of cultivation, nine hundred were spent envying Chen Xuan and plotting for the Tianji Record inheritance, weren't they? Unfortunately, the Tianji Record chose me, not you.'

He paused, his voice suddenly turning cold: 'This question, I ask on behalf of Chen Xuan, my master, for a thousand years—do you feel aggrieved?'

text.content:
Ling Yuan's face twitched violently, the benevolent mask he had maintained for a thousand years completely crumbling at this moment. He ground his teeth, his voice hoarse like a night owl: 'Chen Xuan... Chen Xuan... why! Why could a junior like him gain the Tianji Record's recognition! What do I lack!'

Chen Ji watched silently as this once-revered Sect Elder now revealed such a ferocious face. Yet he felt no satisfaction. He was merely wondering—when the Heavenly Dao's Eye chose such a person as a chess piece, was it his obsession it valued, or his foolishness?

'The answer is simple.' Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice calm as still water. 'Because you... were never the one meant to be a Penholder.'
